name: chat-header
title: Chat header
description: The top of a conversation: avatar or group mosaic, name, presence or member count, and call, search and info actions.
docs: Put it above the thread. conversation is { id, name, image, group, members, memberCount, onlineCount, muted }: a group without an image is drawn as a mosaic of up to four members. presence is { state, lastSeenAt } for a direct chat and gives Active now, Away, Last seen 14:02 (or yesterday, Mon, 12 Oct) or Offline; a group counts its members instead, 12 members, 3 online. status replaces the line with your own words. The avatar and name are one button when onOpenInfo is passed, named Open info for Anna and described by the status line. The status is also a polite status of its own that speaks only once a change has held for a moment, and never when another conversation opens. actions are icon buttons with tooltips: a wide bar keeps maxInline (default 3), a narrow one keeps two, and the rest wait in a More menu. onBack shows a back button on a narrow bar only. muted adds a bell with a line through it and the word Muted. Pass now to get Last seen in server HTML; times use locale and timeZone. labels translates every word.
